head: 2a096303
method: bounded source trace; no browser, server, tests, production requests, or product edits

findings.title: Intake can silently lose the purchase record
findings.reproduction: Enable Save purchase record; let /api/products/bulk succeed and /api/purchase-orders fail for a staged vendor with cost/order data.
findings.impact: Products are created and success is shown, but the requested purchase record is absent; local staging is cleared and server draft closure is attempted.
findings.smallestRemedy: Preserve and expose partial success, retain purchase data for retry, and defer draft closure until requested records finish.

findings.title: Retrying a failed contact save can create a duplicate
findings.reproduction: Let POST /api/customers succeed, fail the subsequent relationships PUT, then click Save again.
findings.impact: The UI reports save failure after a persisted create; retry posts a second contact with a new ID.
findings.smallestRemedy: Use the create payload's existing relationship write and remove the redundant follow-up PUT; retain the created ID if later work needs retry.

findings.title: Manual retry can double-receive a partial stock delivery
findings.reproduction: On a 20-unit open receipt line, submit 5; let the Worker commit but lose the response, or fail the subsequent list refresh; click Receive again on the stale 5-of-20 view.
findings.impact: The second click uses a new key and can add another 5 to stock and the receipt ledger.
findings.smallestRemedy: Keep the intent's idempotency key until a confirmed result and block new receives on stale data pending reconciliation.

coveredWithoutFinding: Curate import panel uses stable creation key within its lifetime.
Curate finalization uses a batch-derived key and server-side replay/resume for receipts and movements.
Stock movement panel retains its intent key across request failure; this pass focused on the separate receipt panel.
highestRiskUntestedJourneys: Interrupted multi-chunk intake after some product chunks succeeded.
Concurrent receive/cancel on the same receipt line by two operators.
Customer profile load when orders, events, or teas fail independently.
